overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong academic and professional social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. Content primarily focuses on computational social science, research grants, tool releases (CooRnet v2.0), and academic recruitment. Engagement is robust across all channels, with high amplification rates on Bluesky and substantial professional interactions on LinkedIn.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published papers, grants, and study findings on coordinated inauthentic behavior and disinformation.
Updates on software development like CooRnet v2.0 and discussions on computational social science methodology.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Mastodon to leverage its audience interest in open science and research tools.
Cross-promote major research milestones across all three platforms simultaneously using tailored tone for each platform.
Incorporate visual elements or direct links to published papers to boost click-through rates and comments.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest engagement rate overall (6.14% average), driven strongly by paper announcements and student opportunities with high repost counts.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche, highly receptive audience for software tools like CooRnet, yielding good boost rates relative to audience size.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850) generating the highest absolute likes and comments, particularly effective for grant announcements and hiring.
